films.desc_en: A premium refreshing commercial for local mountain spring mineral water featuring a sleek unlabelled hero bottle.
films.music: Upbeat summer acoustic guitar and light percussion, refreshing vibe, 110 bpm

shots.kf: Wide shot of the ancient Stone Bridge in Skopje during a hot summer day. Heatwaves shimmer in the air above the cobblestones. The sky is bright blue and cloudless. The Vardar river flows slowly below. Warm, golden sunlight, 35mm lens, photorealistic, cinematic lighting.
shots.motion: Heatwaves shimmer in the air, creating a mirage effect, while the river water ripples gently. Slow camera pan to the right.

shots.kf: A sleek, tall, unlabelled clear glass bottle filled with sparkling water, covered in condensation. The bottle rests on a mossy grey rock next to a fast-flowing mountain stream in the Bistra mountains. Cool, natural daylight, soft shadows, macro photography, 50mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Water flows rapidly in the background stream, and heavy condensation drips down the cold glass bottle. Subtle camera push in.

shots.kf: A sleek, tall, unlabelled clear glass bottle pouring sparkling mineral water into a simple, elegant crystal glass. The setting is a rustic wooden table outdoors. Splashing water droplets catch the bright sunlight. High shutter speed look, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Clear sparkling water flows smoothly from the bottle into the glass, creating lively bubbles and foam. Slow camera truck left.

shots.kf: Extreme close-up of a fresh, bright yellow lemon slice dropping into a glass of sparkling water. Countless tiny bubbles fizz and rise to the surface. Clean white background, high-key studio lighting, vibrant yellow and clear tones, 100mm macro lens, ultra-detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The lemon slice slowly sinks into the liquid, surrounded by thousands of rapidly rising bubbles. The camera remains completely static.

shots.kf: A sleek, tall, unlabelled clear glass bottle filled with sparkling water, covered in cold condensation, standing on a polished dark marble bar counter. Soft, premium warm ambient lighting in the background creates a luxurious atmosphere. 50mm lens, sharp focus, cinematic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A single heavy drop of condensation rolls slowly down the side of the cold, glistening bottle. Slow camera pull back.

films.desc_en: A warm, artisanal commercial for a local craft brewery focusing on the passion of the brewer.
films.music: Warm indie folk with rhythmic clapping and acoustic bass, 105 bpm

shots.kf: A middle-aged male brewer with a thick brown beard, wearing a grey canvas apron over a white t-shirt, standing in a sunlit wooden barn. He is holding a handful of vibrant green hops. Warm morning light streaming through a window. 50mm lens, cinematic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The brewer gently shifts the green hops in his palms, inspecting them in the warm sunlight. Slow camera push in.

shots.kf: Large, shiny copper brewing vats in a pristine, modern craft brewery. Soft white steam rises from the open top hatches. Warm ambient lighting reflects off the polished copper surfaces. Industrial aesthetic, wide angle 24mm lens, deep focus, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Thick white steam billows slowly out of the top hatches of the shiny copper vats. Smooth, slow camera pan right.

shots.kf: A middle-aged male brewer with a thick brown beard, wearing a grey canvas apron over a white t-shirt, carefully pouring rich amber beer from an unlabelled glass pitcher into a classic pint glass. The background is a dimly lit brick wall. 85mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Rich amber beer pours smoothly from the glass pitcher into the pint, creating a thick white head. Slow camera truck left.

shots.kf: Extreme close-up of thick, creamy white foam settling on top of a rich amber craft beer in a glass. Tiny bubbles rise through the golden liquid. Backlit by a warm, golden light source to highlight the beer's color. 100mm macro lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Tiny carbonation bubbles constantly rise through the glowing amber liquid as the thick foam gently settles. The camera remains static.

shots.kf: A middle-aged male brewer with a thick brown beard, wearing a grey canvas apron over a white t-shirt, standing in a cozy brewery taproom. He holds up a pint of glowing amber beer towards the light. Warm string lights in the blurred background. 50mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The brewer raises the pint glass slightly, catching the warm light in the amber beer. Slow camera pull back.

films.desc_en: A high-energy, vertical splash ad for a natural red fruit juice, perfect for TikTok and Reels.
films.music: High energy electronic dance beat with heavy bass drops, 128 bpm

shots.kf: Vertical portrait composition. Fresh, dark red cherries falling into a deep pool of vibrant red splashing fruit juice. Dynamic splash crown, liquid droplets suspended in mid-air. Bright, punchy lighting, high contrast, vivid red and crimson colors. 85mm macro lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The cherries crash into the liquid, creating a massive, chaotic splash of red juice and flying droplets. Fast camera push in.

shots.kf: Vertical portrait composition. A beautiful, fast swirl of thick, rich red fruit juice inside a tall, clear glass. Crushed ice cubes float within the spinning vortex. Backlit to show the translucent ruby red color of the liquid. High shutter speed, 50mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The ruby red juice spins rapidly in a vortex inside the glass, tossing the crushed ice around. Dynamic camera tilt down.

shots.kf: Vertical portrait composition. An unlabelled, elegant glass bottle filled with dark red fruit juice, resting forcefully on a bed of crushed ice. Bright studio lighting with sharp reflections on the wet glass. Vibrant, juicy color palette. 35mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Ice shards settle around the base of the bottle while heavy condensation drips down the cold glass. Fast camera pull back.

films.line_mk: Природен квалитет кој можете да го вкусите.
films.desc_en: A technical yet premium explainer detailing the pristine, automated bottling process of mountain spring water.
films.music: Ambient electronic with pulsing rhythmic synths and soft strings, 95 bpm
vo_mk: Нашата вода извира длабоко во недопрената природа на македонските планини.
Се филтрира природно низ карпите, собирајќи ги најважните минерали.
Нашата модерна технологија ја затвора свежината директно на самиот извор.
Без човечки допир, гарантираме апсолутна чистота во секое шише.
Природен квалитет кој можете да го вкусите секој ден.

shots.kf: A crystal-clear mountain spring gushing out from a crevice in dark, moss-covered rocks. Lush green ferns surround the water source. Soft, diffused daylight filtering through a forest canopy. Bistra mountain setting. 35mm lens, slow shutter speed effect, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Fresh mountain water rushes continuously over the dark, mossy rocks, creating white foam. Slow and smooth camera pan to the right.

shots.kf: An underground cave with walls of smooth, wet limestone. A perfectly still pool of pure, transparent water reflects the rocky ceiling. A single drop falls, creating perfect concentric ripples. Cool, blueish natural light, 50mm lens, mysterious atmosphere, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Concentric ripples expand smoothly across the surface of the glowing underground pool of pure water. Slow camera push in.

shots.kf: A network of polished stainless steel pipes in a highly advanced, sterile bottling facility. The pipes curve elegantly. Bright, even, clinical white lighting reflects off the metal. High-tech industrial aesthetic, 24mm lens, deep depth of field, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Gleaming reflections shift along the curved surfaces of the sterile stainless steel pipes. Smooth, continuous camera truck to the left.

shots.kf: A row of identical, empty, clear glass bottles moving along a metallic conveyor belt. The background is a blurred modern factory environment. Crisp, cool artificial lighting. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field focusing on the middle bottle, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The empty glass bottles glide smoothly and uniformly forward along the automated metallic conveyor belt. The camera tracks alongside them.

shots.kf: Close-up of precise, robotic stainless steel nozzles dispensing clear, sparkling water into a row of glass bottles on a moving production line. High-speed industrial process. Bright, clean lighting, 85mm lens, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Clear water shoots rapidly from the robotic nozzles, filling the moving glass bottles in perfect synchronization. The camera remains static.

shots.kf: Close-up of a mechanical press smoothly securing shiny silver metal caps onto the tops of filled glass water bottles. The bottles are perfectly aligned on the conveyor. Clean, modern factory lighting, 100mm macro lens, sharp focus on the capping mechanism, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The mechanical press rapidly pushes down, sealing the shiny metal caps tightly onto the moving glass bottles. Subtle camera tilt up.

shots.kf: A perfectly aligned row of finished, unlabelled glass bottles filled with pure water, gliding on a conveyor belt towards a bright, glowing, warm light source at the end of the tunnel. Cinematic, optimistic lighting, 50mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The finished bottles move smoothly forward into the warm, glowing light, reflecting bright highlights off the glass. Slow camera pull back.

films.desc_en: An emotional, cinematic journey showing the traditional harvest and rich flavors of premium Macedonian vineyards.
films.music: Slow cinematic orchestral strings with a gentle piano melody, 75 bpm
vo_mk: Сонцето ги буди даровите на нашата земја.

shots.kf: A breathtaking sunrise over the rolling vineyards of the Tikves region in North Macedonia. Soft, ethereal morning mist hangs low between the neat rows of green vines. Warm golden hour sunlight, pastel sky. Wide landscape shot, 24mm lens, cinematic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The morning mist rolls gently over the neat rows of grapevines as the sunlight intensifies. Very slow, sweeping camera pan right.

shots.kf: Extreme close-up of a cluster of perfectly ripe, dark purple grapes hanging on a vine. Glistening dew drops catch the morning light. Deep green leaves in the soft-focus background. Rich, natural colors, 100mm macro lens, soft morning light, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A heavy dew drop slides slowly down the skin of a dark purple grape, catching the golden light. Subtle camera push in.

shots.kf: A rustic, woven wooden basket overflowing with freshly harvested dark purple grapes, sitting on dry, earthy soil in the vineyard. Warm, dappled sunlight filters through the grapevines above. Earth tones and rich purples. 50mm lens, cinematic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Dappled sunlight dances slowly across the surface of the freshly harvested purple grapes in the wooden basket. Slow camera truck left.

shots.kf: Rich, dark purple grape juice flowing smoothly from an antique wooden wine press into a clay pitcher. The deep ruby color of the liquid is highlighted by a shaft of warm sunlight. Rustic, traditional setting, 85mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The thick, ruby-colored juice pours heavily and continuously from the wooden press into the rustic clay pitcher. The camera remains static.

shots.kf: An elegant, unlabelled crystal glass filled with a dark ruby-red beverage, resting on a weathered oak barrel. In the blurred background, a traditional Macedonian stone house is bathed in the golden light of late afternoon. 50mm lens, cinematic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The dark ruby liquid inside the elegant crystal glass settles gently, reflecting the warm afternoon sunlight. Slow camera push in.

shots.kf: A stunning sunset over Lake Ohrid. In the foreground, an unlabelled glass of dark ruby beverage catches the last rays of the sun, glowing from within. The calm water reflects the orange and purple sky. 35mm lens, highly emotional, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The sunset light glows brilliantly through the dark ruby liquid in the glass, while the lake ripples softly. Slow camera pull back.
